spans.s:
प्यै प्यै or प्याय् (developed out of a
Vedic rt. पी; cf. rt. पिन्व्), cl. 1. A. प्या-
यते (Ved. पयते), पिप्ये (Ved. पीपाय), प्यास्-
यते, प्यायिष्यते, अप्यास्त, अप्यायिष्ट, अप्यायि,
प्यातुम्, प्यायितुम्, to swell, become swollen or
distended; to be exuberant; to become full; to
increase, grow; to overflow; to cause to swell,
distend; to fill to excess, overfill, surcharge, cause to
run over or overflow: Caus. प्याययति, -यितुम्,
(with आ, see आ-प्यै.)
